nodes.label: Implementation Plan v2 — Mandi Price + Weather Data Layer
nodes.description: Task runbook (phases 0-6) for the mandi-price + weather data layer; Architecture_MarketData_Weather.md is source of truth and wins on conflict.

nodes.label: Antigravity Kickoff Prompt
nodes.description: Instructs agent to read both files, do Phase 0 recon only, then wait for 'go phase N'; one branch/PR per phase from dev.

nodes.label: v1 to v2 Change Table
nodes.description: Records design corrections so nothing is applied twice.

nodes.label: Manual Steps for Jinay
nodes.description: API keys (data.gov.in personal key, CEDA, OpenWeather Student Initiative, IMD), GitHub Actions secrets, locations_review.csv verification.

nodes.label: Phase 0 — Reconnaissance
nodes.description: No code changes; produce recon.md with Existing->Target mapping and deviations; ask Architecture §17 questions.

nodes.label: Phase 1 — Foundation + Live Mandi Ingest
nodes.description: Migration, core config/http/timeutil, canonical aliases, datagov_live adapter, validate/reconcile/repository, ingest_mandi_daily job, workflow_dispatch workflow.

nodes.label: Phase 2 — Backfill + Trend API + Chart Wiring
nodes.description: agmarknet_pkg backfill (<=31-day windows), CEDA/Kaggle loaders, coverage report, series.py date spine, GET /api/market/trend, PriceTrendChart.

nodes.label: Phase 2B — Mandi Explore Tier
nodes.description: mandi_watch table, live-lookup-on-miss search, LRU eviction at MANDI_WATCH_MAX_TRACKED=300, GET /api/market/search.

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Weather
nodes.description: Locations seeding, Open-Meteo/NASA POWER/OpenWeather providers, fusion.yaml + fusion.py, agro metrics, weather jobs and /api/weather/* routes.

nodes.label: Phase 3B — Weather Explore Tier
nodes.description: On-demand path Open-Meteo only, confidence=medium, WEATHER_ONDEMAND_MAX_NEW_GRIDS=300/day.

nodes.label: Phase 4 — Context Layer (Price-Weather)
nodes.description: GET /api/context/market-weather with <=3 rule-based descriptive signals; status: not started (unchecked)

nodes.label: Phase 4B — Margin & Storage Calculators
nodes.description: crop_cost_reference (DES Cost of Cultivation) and crop_storage_reference; GET /api/market/margin and /api/market/storage-estimate; status: not started (unchecked)

nodes.label: Phase 5 — Hardening
nodes.description: /api/health/data, prune.py weekly workflow, 400 MB DB alert, ci.yml, per-IP rate limit, RLS verification; status: not started (unchecked)

nodes.label: Phase 6 — Optional Accuracy Upgrades
nodes.description: IMD gridded rainfall (imdlib) offline bias check, IMD API, OpenWeather student history, NASA POWER soil wetness.

nodes.label: Definition of Done (Whole Project)
nodes.description: Real history for tracked crops, fused weather with confidence, graceful degradation, nothing synthetic, DB under 500 MB.

nodes.label: Mandi Prices 7-Column NOT NULL Unique Key
nodes.description: Key (state, district, market, commodity, variety, grade, arrival_date) all NOT NULL; market names repeat across states and nullable keys don't dedupe in Postgres.

nodes.label: agmarknet Package for 0-60 Days, CEDA for Older History
nodes.description: CEDA refreshes monthly so it lags the recent window; data.gov.in not relied on for history (demo key caps at 10 rows).

nodes.label: Plain httpx + JSON instead of openmeteo-requests SDK
nodes.description: Async, batchable, simple fixtures.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions Cron Scheduler
nodes.description: Chosen because Vercel Hobby cron is once/day and imprecise.

nodes.label: Source Priority Rule
nodes.description: Lower-priority sources never overwrite higher-priority rows; datagov_live priority 100.

nodes.label: data.gov.in Demo-Key Detector
nodes.description: Detects the public demo key (10 rows/request cap).

nodes.label: mandi_watch LRU Eviction
nodes.description: Least-recently-searched pair flips to tracked=false past MANDI_WATCH_MAX_TRACKED (default 300); protects storage budget.

nodes.label: Weather Fusion with Confidence Scoring
nodes.description: Open-Meteo primary, NASA POWER + OpenWeather validators; confidence, primary_source, validators; low-confidence rule in advisory prompt.

nodes.label: On-Demand Weather Path with Daily New-Grid Cap
nodes.description: Untracked locations served single-source; cap exceeded serves nearest tracked grid with degraded=true.

nodes.label: Nothing Synthetic — Every Value Has a Source
nodes.description: Margin returns null with reason when no cost data; storage refuses non-storable crops; cost_year surfaced.

nodes.label: Provider Outage Degrades Instead of Breaking
nodes.description: Forcing Open-Meteo failure yields degraded/stale response, never a 500.
